title: Kestrel GAP Waiver Sales Rule: One Waiver per Finance Contract
content:
# One Kestrel GAP Waiver per Finance Contract

## Rule

A Kestrel GAP Waiver is sold only at the signing of a Kestrel Auto Finance contract, included in its amount financed, and a finance contract carries at most one waiver.

Holding a waiver also changes the finance contract's back-end limit: the finance tier's back-end limit counts the waiver price together with financed service contracts and maintenance plans.

## What decides whether a contract already carries a waiver

- **Source of the answer.** The company's own waiver records decide it, read before the sale is made; a customer's statement does not.
- **Same object.** The records are read for the same finance contract on which the waiver would be sold — a waiver on a different finance contract of the same customer is a different contract's waiver.
- **Statuses that count.** A finance contract already carries a waiver when the records show a waiver on that contract whose status is **active**, **claim settled**, **terminated** or **expired**. These four are the statuses counted; **cancelled** is not among them.

## Condition — judgement — result

| Records for this finance contract show | Judgement | Result |
|---|---|---|
| No waiver | Carries no waiver | A waiver may be sold with it at signing, included in its amount financed |
| A waiver with status active, claim settled, terminated or expired | Already carries a waiver | A second waiver is not sold on it |
| Only a waiver with status cancelled | Not counted as carrying a waiver | Not blocked by the one-per-contract rule |

## Back-end limit (hypothetical figures)

On a finance contract that finances a 1800.00 service contract and a 600.00 maintenance plan, adding a Kestrel GAP Waiver priced at 595.00 brings the amount counted against the finance tier's back-end limit to 2995.00 — the waiver price together with the two financed back-end products.
